experiment: Missing Boundary Guided Generation for DRAEM
blind_defect_prompt: a ob1 with sks1 sks2 sks3 sks4
random_anomaly_prompt: a ob1 with sks1 sks2 sks3 sks4 (seed 777)

B_random.description: Original + 50 random SeaS anomalies (seed 777 pool, seed 42 selection)

retraining.note: Baseline was trained 700 epochs; retrain models use 200 epochs for comparison

fix1_m_guided_generation.verified: generated M(x) never checked; empirically refs drift (gap 0.10->0.27), M~0.15 only coincidentally near P90

v3_closedloop.mb_definition: M(x) = alpha*Gap_norm + beta*PB, Gap fixed P1/P99 anchor, PB=KDE-PB(bandwidth=0.1)
v3_closedloop.approach: generate -> score(M) -> accept/reject (M gate + RMP mask content gate) -> adaptive noise ladder
v3_closedloop.bd_gate: M >= m_accept_bd (0.8009) AND mask_cov > 0.05 (defect present) AND score in [0.5,0.995]

small_validation.run: 2026-08-12, 1 BN ref + 1 BD ref, 20 candidates -> 16 accepted
